remarks: For Lease - Retail/Office Space | Mid Ridge, Stamford, CT  Approximately 1,900 SF of retail/office space available PLUS 2,000SF of storage for lease in a well-positioned strip center located in Stamford's Mid Ridge neighborhood, just off High Ridge Road. The property offers excellent visibility, ample on-site parking, and convenient access to major thoroughfares and residential communities.  Highlights: 1,950 SF retail/office space (divisible)+ 2,000 SF of Storage. Prominent location in established neighborhood retail center. (Fratelli Market & Chickie's Grill). Ample surface parking for customers and staff. Strong area demographics and steady traffic counts along High Ridge Road. Ownership will consider subdivision. Flexible lease available.  Tenant improvement/build-out options neg. Ideal Uses: Retail, professional office, medical, wellness, or service-oriented businesses. Located in the Mid Ridge section of Stamford, minutes from the Merritt Parkway and downtown Stamford, offering convenience and visibility in a thriving suburban market.
